title: Careers
content: CAREERS AT CHEMIFY Build the future. Make it real. Join the operators, technicians, technologists, chemists, engineers, software developers and AI researchers making chemistry programmable. Bring your expertise to a team where how we work together matters as much as what we build. Explore opportunities CHEMIFY / CAREERS AT CHEMIFY EXPLORE WHAT’S POSSIBLE CULTURE AT CHEMIFY How we work makes the difference. Our culture is as important as our technology. We bring different disciplines together, take ownership, challenge ideas openly and learn from every iteration. Our shared values shape how we build, how we solve problems and how we deliver for our partners. Chemify Academy and internships are part of that commitment: developing people, sharing practical knowledge and creating opportunities to learn across disciplines. 01 Fearlessly Iterate to Accelerate + We fully embrace a rapid iteration culture, focusing on the most important objectives, speed to delivery, quality, fearlessness, embracing the inevitable failures, and enthusiasm to recover from and overcome challenges and setbacks. Deliberately iterating enables Chemify to improve faster, learn faster, and deliver value faster than anybody else. 02 Cross-Functional Nature + Our vision and mission to change the world of chemistry will require the best chemists, software engineers, hardware engineers, data scientists, leaders, operators, and a wide breadth of other deep experts in a variety of fields working seamlessly together. 03 Distributed Leadership + We ignite the potential within each employee who made the decision to join us, fostering a workplace where innovation, collaboration, and personal growth thrive. Our distributed leadership culture ensures agility, accountability, dynamism, and the fastest realization of our exceptional vision for the future of Chemistry. 04 Disagree and Commit + We unlock innovation through constructive conflict. This principle encourages open dialogue and diverse viewpoints during decision-making, ensuring every perspective is considered. Once a decision is made, all team members commit to unified action, driving cohesive and decisive execution. 05 Customer Obsession + We put our customers at the center of everything we do. Their chemistry challenges inspire our innovation, their goals shape our priorities, and their success defines our own. By listening closely and responding with care, we build trusted partnerships that go beyond transactions. Every decision we make is guided by a simple principle: deliver extraordinary value that helps our customers thrive today and tomorrow. OUR SITES Glasgow. San Francisco. One team. Connected across disciplines and time zones. With sites in Glasgow and San Francisco, we work together to turn scientific ambition into real molecules and materials.
